environment: Void Linux; native headless Sway, foot, GIO; 1440x1000; monospace 12; scale 1
data: System desktop entries; temporary Apps preferences; model and voice availability fixtures
checks: Names are lowercase labels; foot helpers start hidden and stand under hidden apps, a list of their own
Browse uses concise desktop-entry roles; role and full-comment searches both find the installed app
Real system Apps and on-demand btop Details render in compact, fullscreen and equal work-area snaps
Returning from Details restores the app search; active query and selected app survive all four modes; clicked Right keycap opens Details
Hide is a switch applied at once with Undo: it leaves the search, stands under hidden apps, and comes back from its details without editing launchers
Native category creation, rename, mapping edit and deletion apply at once, persist and reclassify
At 36x20, long technical values reflow, original launcher path copies, preferences scroll above the reserved populated footer, and Remove has a current hit target
Enter and a second click both launch the installed foot desktop entry; windows outlive the helper; confirmed receipts stay in Apps
The real installed Terminal=true btop entry launches through GIO into foot and its window is confirmed
With two real btop windows, saved Focus existing selects the most recently focused match; Enter and a second click share it without opening a third
Focus existing starts the installed btop application when no matching window remains
After restarting home, btop retains its category override, restored visibility and Focus existing preference
A labelled local desktop-entry fixture shows unavailable package metadata; its declared New window action opens two real foot windows through the saved preference
Explicit adapter failure fixtures verify empty catalog versus unavailable discovery, retry recovery, and launch failure retaining the search
